about_the_game:
The official soundtrack to Asteroid Requiem — a quiet sci-fi game about memory, collapse, and drifting through space.

This 4-track release features ambient electronic compositions with subtle hints of retro arcade texture. If you enjoyed Asteroid Requiem, or just want to support Wizards in Training, please consider this purchase a tip that will be greatly appreciated.

Includes high quality FLAC files.
